description: Two-tone second-order intermodulation and IP2 (conventions: Two-tone intermodulation; ADR 0110).

cases.source: by hand: y = x + 0.1x^2, products 0.1 at 30 and 230 (power 0.005); DC, 200, 260 away
by hand: y = x - 0.05x^2 on cos + 0.5 cos: products a2 A1 A2 = -0.025 at 40 and 560, folded to 464; harmonics 520 -> 504 and 600 -> 424 away
by hand: y = x + 0.2|x|^2 on 0.5(e^{jw1n} + e^{jw2n}): lines 0.05 at +-230 and 2 x 0.05 at DC; nothing at the sum 30
f2 must be at most sample_rate/2
the f2 group has no power
f2 - f1 = 20 falls on the f1 group
f1 + f2 = 79 folds to 49, the f2 group
f2 - f1 = 125 wraps to -3 bins, inside the DC group (half-width 4)
